notes: Six identical LED+resistor+wire blocks are built once as a repeat; copy n uses Arduino pins 7,6,5,4,3,2 and breadboard columns 7,10,13,16,19,22 (LED cathode in the next column).

The breadboard image is drawn with rows f-j in the upper half and a-e in the lower half; catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j) is the upper half, 't' (rows a-e) the lower half. Each resistor bridges the centre gap from the lower to the upper half.
LED anode is placed in the same column strip as the resistor's upper end; cathode is in the adjacent column, wired by a short black jumper to the top negative rail (tn).
Exact rail hole numbers and rows are estimated from the picture. The ground jumper goes from the Arduino GND pin beside pin 13 (assumed GND.1) to the top negative rail.
Resistor value is 220 ohm per the manual; the catalogue resistor label shows 100 ohm but the value prop is set to 220.
